en-US.subtitle: 108 Divya Desams & Panchangam
en-US.promoText: Today's Panchangam for where you are, now with sunrise, sunset and the day's kaalams, and a calendar to look up any date.
en-US.description:
Vedanta Yojana — Yatra Jñānam Pravāhati. Where the journey of knowledge continues.

A home for Sanātana Dharma literature, the 108 Divya Desams, and the daily Panchangam — built to help preserve the stories, places and traditions handed down through generations.

THE 108 DIVYA DESAMS
• Explore all 108 sacred Sri Vaishnava temples, region by region
• Read each temple's details and its Pasurams from the Divya Prabandham
• Open Pasuram texts right inside the app

DAILY PANCHANGAM
• Today's tithi, nakshatram and upcoming Ekadashi, calculated for where you are
• Sunrise, sunset and the day's kaalams
• The Sankalpam for the day
• Pick any date on the calendar to look it up

A GROWING LIBRARY
• Original books, including Jaya: A Journey of the Mahābhārata, Sri Rama Charithram, Srimad Bhagavata Kathasagaram and A Brief Insight to Visishtadvaita Philosophy
• Pick up where you left off, and bookmark chapters
• Adjust the text size and theme for comfortable reading
• Read in English, Tamil, Kannada, Hindi or Telugu

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-in
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking
• Your reading progress, bookmarks and preferences stay on your device
• Location is used only to calculate the Panchangam, and is optional — every other feature works without it
